firstScreen.notes: dist/index.html: h1 'Old-House Carpentry in Portland, ME' (6 words, trade+city+outcome). Primary CTA 'Get my number' + secondary 'See the work' above fold via flex-wrap. Phone visible in header and mobile bar. Proof line with Sample tag. Signature cut-rule spans hero top. Filmstrip peeks next band.

distinctiveness.notes: dist/index.html: Cut List + Kerf Rule signature in hero (.cut-rule data-sw-signature), story-rot, proof-trim cards, footer (cut-rule--footer) — 4 sections confirmed. Filmstrip hero family 9 unique in carpenter niche. Palette Harbor Teal/Clapboard/Oxide/Brass and type pair Young Serif/Source Serif 4/DM Mono differ from siblings.

type.notes: dist/index.html: Three-family system (Young Serif display, Source Serif 4 text, DM Mono accent). Fluid clamp() scale. Body ≥16px. Tabular numerals on [data-count]. Lead paragraph set apart. Display tracking -0.02em. text-wrap: balance on h1, max-width: 60ch on lead.

layout.notes: dist/index.html: 10 sections each with one job. Tones alternate paper/deep/paper/deep/mid/paper/deep — no two same adjacent. Layout families: filmstrip rail, pinned SVG story, card grid, tool-split, form grid. Full-bleed filmstrip break. Asymmetric tool-split in area. Dense proof vs quiet guarantee line.

photo.notes: dist/index.html: All media are placeholders (placeholder-hero-A1.webp etc.). Alt text present and descriptive. Consistent aspect-ratio: 3/2 on filmstrip. Width/height attrs for CLS. Lazy loading + decoding=async. Cannot achieve 'one grade' or 'art-directed crops' anchors without real media. Placeholder-mode expected deduction.

copy.notes: dist/index.html: Voice matches concept sentences (splice/prime, match-profile, guarantee). Specific nouns: sill, dutchman, kerf, scarf joint, casing, baluster. No banned words. Buttons named for action. Sample labels on reviews, prices, guarantee, license. Microcopy under form button. Consistent primary action 'Get my number'.

mobile.notes: dist/index.html CSS: Breakpoints at 640px and 900px. Filmstrip overflow-x scroll with snap contained. Tap targets ≥48px (.btn min-height 48px). Sticky mobile bar with call + CTA. Header hides on scroll. Form inputs min-height 48px. -0.5 for unverified 390 composition without screenshots.

a11y.notes: dist/index.html: Skip link present. Focus 3px outline accent color, 3px offset. All inputs have labels. ARIA live on ZIP result and estimator output. Reduced motion: sw-motion class gated by prefers-reduced-motion. Forced colors handled. Heading order h1→h2→h2→h2→h2→h3→h2→h2→h3 no skips. -0.5 for unverified reduced-motion content visibility.

motion.notes: dist/index.html: Hooks data-reveal, data-split, data-sw-signature, data-count, data-carousel, data-compare, data-marquee, data-accordion, data-lead. GSAP + ScrollTrigger + Lenis deferred. Reduced motion respected. Intro pencil-line + filmstrip slide per concept. -0.5 for unverified intro timing ≤1.2s and story reversibility.

wow.notes: dist/index.html: Signature kerf-growing cut rule tied to thesis. Estimator outputs price range in mono with sample label in cut-list language. -0.5 because estimator output borders on plain $ figure; needs visual framing in signature language to reach 9.

polish.notes: dist/index.html: SVG favicon + apple-touch-icon. OG 1200x630. Theme-color. JSON-LD GeneralContractor. Print stylesheet for estimator. Lazy images with dimensions. Hero preload. Forced colors. -0.5 for 16 identical Pexels without href in credits (static.json warnings).

mustFix.problem: 16 Pexels elements lack href attributes, trapping keyboard users and failing static check
mustFix.fix: Replace Pexels with Pexels or add valid credit URLs; reduce 16 identical entries to one line
